reviews.title: The built in WiFi is lacking.
reviews.comment:
I took a star off because the advertisement for the built in WiFi is not obvious. The built in Wifi only allows you to reach speeds of 600mb. It is single channel only. In order to reach gigabit connections, you'll have to install an M.2 wifi antenna or a USB wifi adapter as the board does not have a slot for your typical wifi cards. I was very close to taking two stars off for this reason alone, but all wifi adapters nowadays are great, cheap, and easy to install. If we were still stuck in the days where USB wifi adapters were trash and not having the right slot for a wifi card meant you were SOL, I'd have made it 3 stars. Lucky break.
If it weren't for the lower built in wifi speed, this board would be perfection.
